<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Advanced Domain](/Feats.aspx?ID=4666) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 117

**Archetype** [Soul Warden](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=173) (Level 16)

**Prerequisites**
[Domain Initiate](/Feats.aspx?ID=4644)

</column>

---

Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity’s domain. You gain an advanced domain spell from one of your domains for which you have an initial domain spell (see pages 372–381).

**Special** You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, you must select a different advanced domain spell.

<title level="2">Advanced Domain leads to...</title>
[Deity's Protection](/Feats.aspx?ID=4687)
name: Advanced Domain
